problem.title: Clone a Binary Tree with Random Pointers
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree in which every node contains left, right, and random pointers, construct a deep copy of the entire tree while preserving all pointer relationships.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the tree, including the random pointer of every node.
problem.output: • Print the cloned tree in the required format.
